content.text:
I changed `totalPaidCents` in `src/services/order-service.js` so the paid total leaves out orders from soft-deleted users. It still uses callbacks. It now runs two queries one after the other: first it gets the users whose `deleted_at` is null, then it adds up only the paid, non-deleted orders that belong to those users. If either query fails, the error goes to the callback. I didn't run the tests, as you asked.

**One existing test will fail:** `tests/order-service.test.js` ("totalPaidCents counts only paid orders") still expects `4200 + 9900 + 500`. The 500 is order 13, which belongs to Alan (user 3), and Alan is soft-deleted in the seed data. With this change the total is `4200 + 9900` (14100). I left the test alone because you only asked for the function change. When you run the tests, update that assertion to `4200 + 9900`, or I can do it.
